```plato

    // Meta (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conway_polyhedron_notation): every
    // n-gon becomes 2n triangles — the barycentric subdivision of the surface,
    // and the finest of the operators that keeps every original vertex. m = kj = db.
    // V' = V + E + F, E' = 6E, F' = 2C.
    Meta(self: PolygonMesh3D): PolygonMesh3D
        => PolygonMeshOfFaces(
            self.SubdividedVertices,
            Concatenate(
                self.CornerCount.MapRange(c => self.MetaFirstFaceOfCorner(CornerIndex(c))),
                self.CornerCount.MapRange(c => self.MetaSecondFaceOfCorner(CornerIndex(c)))));
```
